summary: Toggle Shockwave to deal 1d4 Thunder in a 10 ft radius every time you land from a qualifying Jump or Fly.

fields.Weapon profile: 2d6 Bludgeoning plus Strength modifier, 5 ft melee. Martial, heavy, two-handed, and dippable.
fields.Shockwave: Each qualifying landing while enabled deals 1d4 Thunder in a 10 ft radius, including multiple jumps made through Step of the Wind. The item source reports Fly and similar landing movement can also trigger it.
fields.Tenacity: In the main hand, when you miss a melee attack, spend your Reaction to deal Bludgeoning equal to Strength modifier, minimum 1.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee weapon attack. On hit, a Constitution save against the hybrid DC prevents Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed removes Dexterity AC bonus, gives disadvantage on Wisdom saves, and blocks actions that spend the Reaction resource.
fields.Backbreaker: Action once per Short Rest. Attack a Large or smaller creature for 1d4 Bludgeoning plus attack ability modifier. Strength save against weapon-action DC or Prone for 2 turns.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
